ns0:svg.ns0:title: A fixed vector and a smoothly changing two-dimensional basis grid
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: The vector x stays at (1, 2). The olive and mustard scaled basis arrows are arranged head to tail, always ending at the tip of x.
